name: Marquee Screens Hero
description: A tight headline over rows of markup-built product screens drifting in opposite directions, masked at the edges, slowing under the pointer, with a tabletop tilt.

props.name: eyebrow
props.default: "Halyard 3.0 · Freight ops for teams under twenty"
props.description: Mono line above the headline, after a small accent dot.

props.name: headline
props.default: "Run freight like a team of fifty."
props.description: Display headline, balanced to about 15ch; its words rise in one after another.

props.name: primary
props.description: Solid ink pill with an arrow that nudges on hover.

props.name: secondary
props.description: Quiet underlined link beside the primary action.

props.name: product
props.description: Product name in every frame header and in the screen-reader description of the rows.

props.name: screens
props.type: { title: string; meta?: string; body: ReactNode }[]
props.description: The screens the rows are built from, drawn in markup on a 320 × 176 canvas. Each row starts three screens further along so no two rows line up. Defaults to eight Halyard screens: shipments, tracking, invoice, reliability, customs, carrier chat, pickups and quotes.

props.name: rows
props.description: How many rows drift under the copy, 2 or 3. Neighbouring rows run in opposite directions at slightly different speeds.

props.name: speed
props.description: Drift speed in px per second. The row under the pointer glides down to a fifth of it; rows pause offscreen and in hidden tabs.

props.name: tilt
props.description: Lays the rows on a tabletop: tipped back 24° and turned −7°, springing between poses.

props.name: align
props.description: Copy alignment. Left splits headline and body into two columns on wide containers.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one signal colour: the eyebrow dot and the live or selected thing on each screen (a moving vessel, today’s pickups, the booked quote).

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black stage with charcoal screens, or a daylight grey stage with white ones.

controls.label: Headline
controls.default: Run freight like a team of fifty.
